title: Release Susi 0.21.47 as the installed Windows production release
goal: Carry the current origin/main (0.21.46 plus the open-core split) through native integration and production qualification as 0.21.47, promote it over release F (0.21.43) with a verified rollback and restore, re-measure the installed entry point against the 0.21.43 baseline (version 92 ms, help 88 ms, status 1.8 s, one goal 11.7 s), and record the evidence.
